description:
Search live property listings across Iraq — apartments, houses, villas, land, offices and shops — for sale or rent in Erbil, Baghdad, Sulaymaniyah, Duhok, Kirkuk and other cities.

Filter by city, neighborhood, price, bedrooms, bathrooms and rental frequency. Results come back as visual cards showing the photo, price, size and listing agency, and every card links straight to the full listing on homele.com.

You can also browse new development projects, look up agencies by city, and open interactive land-plot maps for areas that have them.

Ask in English, Arabic, Kurdish or Turkish — titles, locations and links come back in the language you used.

defaultPrompt: Find 2-bedroom apartments for rent in Erbil under $600 a month
Show me houses for sale in Baghdad under $200,000
What new residential projects are being built in Erbil?
